question: The Seventh five year plan was started in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1985**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Seventh Five-Year Plan** of India was implemented during the period from **1985 to 1990**. ***Hence, the correct answer is 1985.***
 
• This plan was launched under the leadership of Prime Minister **Rajiv Gandhi**, focusing on the modernization of the Indian economy through **science and technology**.
 
• The central theme and objective of the Seventh Plan were summarized by the slogan: **"Food, Work, and Productivity"**.
 
• A landmark feature of this plan was that it sought to improve the **efficiency and productivity** of the **private sector**, marking a shift where the private sector was given priority over the public sector for the first time in India's planning history.
 
• The plan was highly successful in terms of economic growth, achieving an actual **growth rate of 6.01%**, which significantly surpassed the set target of **5.0%**.
